<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于on-policy训练和专家黄金轨迹引导的方法在专家模型无法解决更困难问题时，会失去主要的监督来源，失败轨迹通常被当作负样本丢弃。作者认为这些失败轨迹（Golden Negative Trajectories）在被视为需要反思的有缺陷轨迹而非模仿示范时，仍然能提供有价值的推理信号。

Method: ReflectRL框架包含两个核心阶段：(1) 使用Golden Negative Trajectories引导模型产生反思推理（Reflective Reasoning），即让模型基于有缺陷的轨迹进行反思而非从零开始解题；(2) 通过Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition机制，将反思推理中习得的行为迁移回直接推理（Direct Reasoning）模式，确保模型能够独立解题。该框架是轻量级、即插即用的，可适配多种on-policy训练方法。

Result: 在9个基准测试、4种LLM骨干模型和4种on-policy训练方法上的实验表明，ReflectRL一致性地提升了推理性能，且仅引入极小的计算开销。

Conclusion: 作者识别出"反思优势"（Reflection Advantage）：对于困难问题，反思一个有缺陷的轨迹比直接从零开始解题更容易且更有效。这一洞察为利用失败轨迹提供了新的范式，超越了传统上仅将其视为负样本的做法。

Abstract: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. However, when the expert fails on harder problems, existing trajectory-guided methods lose their main source of supervision, and these failed trajectories are typically discarded as negative samples. We argue that such failures, which we call Golden Negative Trajectories, can still provide valuable reasoning signals when treated not as demonstrations to imitate, but as flawed trajectories to reflect upon. We identify a Reflection Advantage: for hard problems, reflecting on a flawed trajectory can be easier and more effective than solving the problem directly from scratch. Motivated by this, we propose ReflectRL, a lightweight plug-and-play framework that learns from Golden Negative Trajectories during on-policy training. ReflectRL first uses these trajectories to elicit Reflective Reasoning, then applies Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition to transfer the acquired reasoning behavior back to Direct Reasoning. Experiments across 9 benchmarks, 4 LLM backbones, and 4 on-policy training methods show that ReflectRL consistently improves reasoning performance with minimal overhead.

</details>

### [331] [Speculative Successive Cancellation Decoding of Polar Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02760)
*Ryan Seah,Marvin Rübenacke,Warren J. Gross*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出推测式连续消除（Spec-SC）框架，将推测执行引入SC解码过程，允许在不符合特殊节点模式的一般节点上进行并行执行，并通过内置验证机制确保正确性。仿真显示Spec-SC在保持与标准SC相同的BER和FER性能的同时，将顺序遍历节点数平均减少高达69%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Polar码随码长增加可达信道容量，但传统SC解码算法本质上是顺序执行的，限制了其在高吞吐量应用中的实用性。现有的基于特殊节点的解码器仅能对特定的预定义结构实现部分并行，无法覆盖一般节点。

Method: 提出推断式连续消除（Spec-SC）框架，将推测执行概念融入SC解码过程。与仅能处理特定特殊节点模式的节点级解码器不同，Spec-SC允许在不匹配任何特殊节点模式的一般节点上进行并行执行，并配有内置验证机制确保推测不会损害解码正确性。

Result: 仿真结果表明，对于码长N=4096的Polar码，Spec-SC在达到与标准SC解码相同的BER和FER性能的同时，将平均顺序遍历节点数减少了高达69%。

Conclusion: Spec-SC能够实现超越特殊节点方法所能达到的额外算法级并行性，为推测式硬件解码器实现铺平了道路。

Abstract: Polar codes achieve channel capacity as block length increases, but this asymptotic advantage comes at the cost of decoding speed: the conventional successive cancellation (SC) algorithm is inherently sequential, which limits its practicality for high-throughput applications. This work addresses that limitation by introducing the \emph{Speculative Successive-Cancellation} (Spec-SC) framework, which incorporates speculative execution into the SC decoding process. While node-based decoders with special nodes enable partial parallelism for specific, predefined structures, Spec-SC extends this capability by permitting parallel execution in general nodes that do not match any special-node pattern. A built-in verification mechanism ensures that this speculation does not compromise decoding correctness. Simulation results show that Spec-SC achieves identical BER and FER performance to standard SC decoding, while reducing the average number of sequentially traversed nodes by up to $69\%$ for a polar code of length $N=4096$. These results demonstrate that Spec-SC enables additional algorithm-level parallelism beyond what special-node approaches alone can achieve, paving the way for speculative hardware decoder implementations.

</details>


### [332] [Tight Information Complexity of the Coin Problem in the Broadcast Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02776)
*Hadi Kazemi,Varun Jog*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究广播（共享黑板）模型下的分布式假设检验问题，即区分两类伯努利分布Ber(α)与Ber(β)。对于恒定优势的协议，作者刻画了任意β<α下两种假设的信息复杂度（精确到常数因子），识别出三个参数区间，分别对应基于干净样本、二元对称信道和不对称Z信道的三种最优协议。下界依赖于一篇新的混合Hellinger–Jensen–Shannon不等式。文章同时刻画了任意离散分布测试的信息复杂度，并应用于集合不相交下界和多遍流式计算下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式假设检验是分布式计算与统计推断的基础问题，而广播模型（共享黑板模型）是一种重要的通信拓扑。此前对伯努利分布检验在广播模型下的信息复杂度（两种假设分别的通信代价）缺乏完整的刻画，且两种信息代价的差异未得到认识。此外，现有方法在推广到任意离散分布时缺乏统一框架，需要更一般的下界技术。

Method: (1) 对伯努利检验问题，给出了信息复杂度的精确到常数因子的刻画，识别出三个参数区间并构造相应最优协议：干净样本、二元对称信道（BSC）和不对称Z信道。(2) 下界技术采用新提出的混合Hellinger–Jensen–Shannon不等式。(3) 对任意离散分布测试，将信息复杂度归结为一个关于信道的优化问题，证明二元输出信道即足够。(4) 对有限似然比分布给出界，并以χ²散度给出通用上界。

Result: (1) 完整刻画了Ber(α) vs Ber(β)在广播模型下的恒定优势信息复杂度，证明了两种假设下的信息代价可以显著不同。(2) 建立了新的混合Hellinger–Jensen–Shannon不等式，作为下界技术。(3) 将任意离散分布检验的信息复杂度转化为信道优化问题，并证明二元输出信道最优性。(4) 给出了基于χ²散度的通用上界。(5) 作为应用，恢复了广播模型下的集合不相交问题下界，并为多遍流式计算中的若干问题提供了更强的下界。

Conclusion: 本文对广播模型下伯努利分布检验给出了完整的、紧到常数因子的信息复杂度刻画，揭示了在不同参数区间下最优协议的结构（干净样本/BSC/Z信道）。所提出的混合Hellinger–Jensen–Shannon不等式是一个可独立使用的通用下界工具，有望在更广泛的分布式假设检验与通信复杂度问题中发挥作用。对任意离散分布和流式计算场景的推广进一步扩展了该框架的适用范围。

Abstract: We study distributed testing of $\mathrm{Ber}(α)$ versus $\mathrm{Ber}(β)$ in the broadcast, or shared-blackboard, model. For protocols with constant advantage, we characterise up to universal constant factors the information complexity under either hypothesis for every pair $β<α$. The characterisation shows that the two information costs can be quite different and identifies three parameter regimes, with optimal protocols based respectively on clean samples, a noisy binary symmetric channel, and an asymmetric $Z$-channel. The lower bounds rely on a novel mixed Hellinger--Jensen--Shannon inequality that may be of independent interest. We also characterise the constant-advantage information complexity of testing arbitrary discrete distributions via an optimisation problem over channels, and show that binary-output channels suffice. We obtain bounds for bounded likelihood-ratio distributions, and give general upper bounds in terms of $χ^2$ divergence. As applications, we recover the broadcast-model set-disjointness lower bound, and derive stronger lower bounds in the multi-pass streaming setting for some problems considered in prior work.

</details>


### [333] [On the Minimum Field Size of Network MDS Codes for Generalized Combination Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03209)
*Qin Zhou,Fang-Wei Fu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究了网络最大距离可分（MDS）码所需的最小域大小，针对广义组合网络和Zosin-Khuller网络，建立了标量和向量网络MDS码的系统框架，推导了存在性的充要条件并改进了最小域大小的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络MDS码的最小所需域大小是影响网络节点计算复杂度的关键参数。先前研究仅提供通用上界，缺乏系统性的分析方法来精确刻画不同网络拓扑下的最小域大小需求。

Method: 本文采用以下方法：(1) 将广义组合网络上标量网络码的最小距离等价于经典线性码的最小汉明距离，将网络级MDS约束转化为编码理论条件；(2) 利用覆盖Grassmannian码刻画存在性条件；(3) 通过精细贪心构造和MRD码设计改进最小域大小上界；(4) 对向量网络码建立类似的距离等价关系；(5) 对Zosin-Khuller网络使用超图同态和子集交参数来推导下界。

Result: 获得了广义组合网络上标量和向量MDS码的充要存在条件，改进了最小域大小上界；发现在若干参数区间标量与向量MDS码的最优域大小差距消失，并明确识别出一类向量编码无优势的网络族；对Zosin-Khuller网络推导了严格优于标量界的最少有效域大小下界，并给出基于超图同态的向量MDS构造的充要条件。

Conclusion: 本文系统地推进了网络MDS码最小域大小的理论刻画，揭示了标量与向量MDS码之间的关系，证明了在某些网络族中向量编码并不带来域大小上的优势，并通过超图同态工具实现了对Zosin-Khuller网络的精确刻画。

Abstract: This paper investigates the minimum field size required for network maximum distance separable (MDS) codes, a critical parameter affecting computational complexity at network nodes. Focusing on generalized combination networks and Zosin Khuller networks, we develop a systematic framework for both scalar and vector network MDS codes. For scalar codes on generalized combination networks, we establish an equivalence between the minimum distance of network codes and the minimum Hamming distance of classical linear codes, converting network-level MDS constraints into coding theory conditions. This yields necessary and sufficient existence conditions linked to classical MDS codes and covering Grassmannian codes. Using refined greedy constructions and MRD code designs, we obtain improved bounds on the minimum field size, outperforming the prior universal bound. For vector network codes, we develop an analogous distance equivalence and characterize existence via covering Grassmannian codes, yielding bounds on the minimum effective field size. Notably, the gap between optimal scalar and vector MDS codes vanishes for several parameter regimes; we explicitly identify a family of such networks where vector coding offers no field size advantage over scalar coding. For Zosin Khuller networks, we derive lower bounds on the minimal effective field size of vector MDS codes using hypergraph homomorphisms and subset intersection arguments, strictly improving prior scalar bounds. We further provide a necessary and sufficient condition built upon hypergraph homomorphisms for vector MDS construction, yielding an upper bound on the minimum field size. Finally, we bound the MDS gap between optimal scalar and vector solutions.

</details>


### [334] [Reliability-Dependent Scaling Laws of Deterministic Identification over Binary Symmetric Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03282)
*Zhicheng Liu,Liuquan Yao,Guiying Yan,Zhiming Ma,Zechun Hu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究了二进制对称信道（BSC）上确定性识别（DID）在消失错误约束下的渐近行为。通过引入最小误差参数，刻画了不同错误衰减域（大偏差、中偏差、中心极限）对DID可达速率的影响，并给出了通用可达性和逆界。结果表明DID的渐近行为由信道输出的汉明壳集中几何决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性识别（DID）是识别码理论中的一个重要研究方向，其与传统传输码在速率-错误权衡上存在本质区别。此前对DID在BSC上的渐近行为理解尚不充分，特别是在不同错误衰减机制下，最小误差参数如何影响DID速率的刻画仍属空白。本文旨在系统性地填补这一理论缺口。

Method: 本文采用了两条互补的分析路径：（1）可达性方面，将编码理论构造与概率集中技术相结合，推导出一般可达性界；（2）逆界方面，通过全变差距离和汉明型界，将统计可区分性与DID码的最小距离结构联系起来。在此基础上，分别在大偏差、中偏差和中心极限三个误差衰减域中给出显式渐近刻画。

Result: 推导出了DID在BSC上的通用可达性和逆界，并在大偏差、中偏差和中心极限三个区间内得到了显式的渐近速率-误差特征。关键发现是DID在BSC上的渐近行为由信道输出的汉明壳集中几何所主导，这为理解离散输出信道上确定性识别的有限块长行为提供了新视角。

Conclusion: 本文的研究深化了对确定性识别码在BSC上渐近性能的理解，揭示了汉明壳集中几何作为核心机制的作用，并为后续在更一般的离散输出信道上研究DID的有限块长行为奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the asymptotic behavior of deterministic identification (DID) over binary symmetric channels (BSCs) under vanishing error constraints. By introducing a minimum error parameter, we characterize how different error-decay regimes affect the achievable DID rate. General achievability and converse bounds are derived, with explicit asymptotic characterizations in the large-deviation, moderate-deviation, and central-limit regimes. The achievability analysis combines coding-theoretic constructions with probabilistic concentration techniques, while the converse links statistical distinguishability to the minimum-distance structure of DID codes via total variation and Hamming-type bounds. Our results show that the asymptotic behavior of DID over BSCs is governed by a Hamming-shell concentration geometry of channel outputs, offering insights into the finite-blocklength behavior of deterministic identification over discrete-output channels.

</details>


### [335] [Frequency-Position-Fluid Antenna Array and Beamforming for Ultra-dense Connectivity in Terahertz Wireless Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03289)
*Heyin Shen,Chong Han,Jinhong Yuan*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向太赫兹超密集连接场景的动态频率-位置流体天线（D-FPFA）架构，通过可调本振接入不同子带扩展带宽，利用可移动子阵和天线实现空间分集，并结合波束分裂感知的频率分配与天线位置-预编码联合优化，相比传统相移器阵列结构显著提升频谱效率与能量效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太赫兹通信需要支持超密集连接，但传统固定相移器阵列架构在带宽利用、空间分集和能量效率方面存在局限，难以在近场宽带场景下有效应对波束分裂和干扰问题。

Method: （1）提出D-FPFA架构，在射频链中集成频率可调本振以访问不同子带，提供频域分集；基站采用可移动子阵、用户配备可移动天线，提供空间分集。（2）设计两阶段波束分裂感知频率分配策略：第一阶段按信道相关稀疏划分用户至不同子带以抑制干扰；第二阶段分析平面阵列宽近场波束分裂效应，揭示非中心子载波光束无法在单一空间点完美重聚焦的散光现象，将用户分组任务建模为最小支配集问题。（3）引入开关网络和基于距离的天线选择策略以应对近场信道增益变化，随后用粒子群优化算法联合优化天线位置和预编码器以最大化总速率。

Result: 仿真结果表明，D-FPFA相比传统相移器（PS）阵列子阵结构可获得约2.3倍的速率提升；达到其延迟线（TTD）架构95%的速率，同时能量效率约为其2.8倍；全连接变体FPFA在所有考虑的架构中能量效率最高。

Conclusion: D-FPFA通过频率与位置双重动态自由度，有效兼顾了频谱效率和能量效率，为太赫兹超密集连接提供了有前景的架构方案，其中FPFA在全连接场景下展现出最优的能量效率。

Abstract: To support ultra-dense connectivity in terahertz (THz) communications, this paper proposes a dynamic frequency-position-fluid antenna (D-FPFA) architecture. Frequency-tunable local oscillators (LOs) are integrated into the RF chains to access different sub-bands, thereby expanding the total bandwidth of the system and providing frequency-domain diversity. To exploit spatial diversity, the base station employs movable subarrays, and each user is equipped with a movable antenna. We first develop a two-phase beam-split-aware frequency allocation strategy. In the first phase, we divide users into disjoint sub-bands according to their channel correlation coefficients to mitigate the interference. In the second phase, we investigate the wideband near-field beam-split effect for planar arrays and reveal an astigmatism phenomenon, in which the beam at a non-central subcarrier cannot be perfectly refocused at a single spatial point. Then, we establish a beam split multiplexing strategy, where we formulate the user grouping task as a minimum dominating set problem. To maximize the sum rate, we introduce a switch network along with a distance-based antenna selection strategy to account for the near-field channel gain variations, followed by a particle swarm optimization-based algorithm that jointly optimizes the antenna positions and precoders. Numerical results show that, the proposed D-FPFA achieves approximately 2.3 times the sum rate of a conventional phase-shifter (PS)-based array-of-subarrays (AoSA) architecture. It also attains 95% of the sum rate of its TTD counterpart while providing approximately 2.8 times its energy efficiency (EE). Moreover, the fully connected variant of D-FPFA, i.e., FPFA, achieves the highest EE among all considered architectures.

</details>


### [336] [Pilot-Assisted Faster-than-Nyquist Signaling for HRLLC: A Non-Asymptotic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03479)
*Ahmet Oguz Kislal,Melda Yuksel,Ali Gorcin,Halim Yanikomeroglu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究了更快奈奎斯特（FTN）信令在超可靠低延迟通信（HRLLC）短包场景中的性能表现，推导了不匹配解码下带参数s的随机编码联合界（RCUs），并展示了在优化功率分配和导频开销后，FTN相比奈奎斯特信令可获得最高2dB的SNR增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统FTN研究大多假设完美信道状态信息，但这一假设在任务关键的HRLLC场景中不切实际。在短包体制下，需要预留导频符号以进行可靠的信道估计，因此亟需在考虑不完美信道估计的情况下分析FTN系统的可达错误概率，为非渐近设计提供理论依据。

Method: 在短块长体制下，考虑不完美信道估计（预留部分导频符号）的场景，推导了带参数s的随机编码联合界（RCUs bound）用于FTN系统的失配解码分析，以刻画可达错误概率。

Result: 数值结果表明，在优化功率分配和导频开销的情况下，FTN信令相比奈奎斯特信令可获得最高2dB的SNR增益。

Conclusion: 研究强调了非渐近（有限块长）分析对于设计高效的新一代HRLLC-FTN系统的必要性，为下一代超可靠低延迟通信系统中FTN的实际部署提供了理论基础。

Abstract: This paper investigates the performance of faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling within the context of hyper-reliable low-latency communications (HRLLC), specifically focusing on the challenges imposed by the short-packet regime. While traditional Nyquist-based systems maintain symbol orthogonality to prevent inter-symbol interference (ISI), FTN intentionally introduces ISI to achieve higher transmission rates. While many existing FTN studies assume perfect channel state information, this assumption is often impractical for mission-critical HRLLC. In such scenarios, a portion of the limited packet length must be reserved for pilot symbols to ensure reliable estimation. To characterize the achievable error probability while accounting for imperfect channel estimation in the short-blocklength regime, we derive the random coding union bound with parameter $s$ (RCUs) under mismatched decoding for FTN systems. The numerical results demonstrate that FTN provides up to a 2 \dB SNR gain over Nyquist signaling, provided that power allocation and pilot overhead are optimized. These findings highlight the necessity of non-asymptotic analysis for designing efficient, next-generation HRLLC-FTN systems.

</details>


### [337] [Permutation Decoding of AG Codes from Curves Defined by Separated Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03592)
*Alonso S. Castellanos,Guilherme Tizziotti,Wilson Olaya-León*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究代数几何（AG）码的置换译码方法，针对由分离多项式定义的代数曲线。通过利用底层曲线的自同构构造AG码的置换自同构，并利用轨道结构确定信息和校验位置。提出SAP曲线（分离加性多项式曲线）类，研究其上定义的一点AG码，获得能纠正坐标共享的爆错误（burst errors）的置换译码集，并识别包含Hermitian曲线、广义Hermitian曲线及某些极大曲线的特殊子类，这些子类可借助额外自同构获得更强译码集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 置换译码（permutation decoding）是一种利用码的置换自同构进行译码的有效方法，但其核心难点在于需要构造足够大的置换自同构群以及确定合适的信息和校验位置。对于代数几何码，寻找足够的置换自同构一直是个挑战。本文旨在通过构造一类新的代数曲线（SAP曲线），利用其自同构结构为AG码提供有效的置换译码方案，特别是针对爆错误的纠正。

Method: 本文提出SAP曲线（Separated Additive Polynomial curves），即由分离多项式定义的一类代数曲线。利用这些曲线自同构群中的元素构造AG码的置换自同构；通过分析码字坐标在自同构作用下的轨道结构，确定信息和校验位置；基于轨道分解设计能纠正特定类型爆错误的置换译码集。此外，识别特殊SAP曲线子类（包括Hermitian曲线、广义Hermitian曲线和某些极大曲线），利用其额外自同构构造更强大的译码集。

Result: 针对SAP曲线上的一个点AG码，获得了能够纠正支撑在共享公共坐标的有理点对应坐标上的爆错误的置换译码集。对于特殊SAP曲线子类（Hermitian曲线、广义Hermitian曲线及某些极大曲线），利用额外自同构构造了更强力的置换译码集。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入SAP曲线类，为代数几何码提供了新的置换译码构造方法，特别针对爆错误场景取得了有效结果，并将Hermitian曲线、广义Hermitian曲线及某些极大曲线纳入统一框架，展示了这些已知优良曲线上的AG码可获得更强置换译码能力。

Abstract: In this work, we investigate permutation decoding for algebraic geometry (AG) codes arising from algebraic curves defined by separated polynomials. Using automorphisms of the underlying curves, we construct permutation automorphisms of the associated algebraic geometry codes and exploit the resulting orbit structure to determine information and check positions. We introduce a class of curves, called SAP curves (Separated Additive Polynomial curves), and investigate one-point AG codes defined on them. For these codes, we obtain permutation decoding sets that correct burst errors supported on coordinates associated with rational points sharing a common coordinate. We further identify a subclass of special SAP curves, including Hermitian curves, generalized Hermitian curves, and certain maximal curves, for which additional automorphisms yield more powerful decoding sets.

</details>


### [338] [Predictive Triggering for Outage-Resilient Threshold Decisions over Short-Packet Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03750)
*Nho-Duc Tran,Aamir Mahmood,Mikael Gidlund*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究短包无线链路下基于远程阈值决策的可行性与能量优化问题。通过推导误报/漏报可行性条件定义决策可行区域，提出预测性决策-更新触发机制，并引入AoI控制的弹性更新以抵御中断。利用匹配一步切换统计的两状态马尔可夫代理模型进行长期可靠性与能量分析，联合优化发射功率和AoI控制弹性更新概率。仿真表明该方法相比基线能在竞争性能源消耗下实现更早、更可靠的决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程阈值决策不仅需要准确的状态估计，后验分布还需支持可靠的报警/不报警决策，并尽可能提前预测关键决策。然而，短包无线链路的有限块长和中断风险使得在资源受限条件下同时保证决策可靠性和及时性成为挑战。

Method: 1) 推导误报/漏报可行性条件，定义估计的决策可行区域；2) 提出预测性决策-更新触发机制；3) 引入AoI控制的弹性更新来保护预测更新免受中断，同时检测中断并维持信息新鲜度；4) 构造匹配阈值过程一步切换统计的两状态马尔可夫代理模型，实现可处理的长期可靠性-能量分析；5) 联合优化发射功率和AoI控制弹性更新概率。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方案在竞争性能源消耗下实现了更早且可靠的决策，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过决策可行区域分析与AoI控制的弹性更新机制，实现了短包无线链路上可靠而及时的远程阈值决策，验证了所提联合优化框架的有效性。

Abstract: Remote threshold decisions require more than accurate state estimates: the posterior must support reliable alarm/no-alarm decisions and, when possible, anticipate early critical decisions. We study this problem over short-packet wireless links with outage risk. We derive false-positive/false-negative feasibility conditions that define a decision-feasible region of the estimation and yield a predictive decision-update trigger. To protect predictive updates from outages, we add AoI-controlled resilience updates that both detect disruptions and maintain freshness. A two-state Markov surrogate of the thresholded process, matched to its one-step switching statistics, enables tractable long-term reliability-energy analysis. Then, we jointly optimized transmit power and AoI-controlled resilience update probabilities. Simulations show earlier, reliable decisions at competitive energy with baselines.

</details>


### [339] [Power Minimization under Quality of Service Constraints for MIMO Systems with a RIS-based Transmitter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03829)
*Erico S. P. Lopes,Lukas T. N. Landau,Amine Mezghani*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种基于可重构智能表面（RIS）发射机的虚拟多用户MIMO系统，在QoS约束下最小化发射功率。针对离散相移RIS模型，分别以符号错误概率（SEP）和联合界SEP作为QoS准则，提出了部分分支定界（PBB）方法以实现复杂度和性能的权衡，并针对高分辨率RIS提出了基于斜流形的二等分法以降低计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RIS辅助的虚拟多用户MIMO系统中，需要在满足服务质量（QoS）约束的条件下最小化发射功率，同时解决离散相移RIS带来的计算复杂度过高的问题，以实现功率效率与计算复杂度之间的平衡。

Method: 将功率最小化问题分为两个场景：QPSK调制下采用SEP作为QoS准则，一般M-PSK调制下采用联合界SEP（UBSEP）作为QoS约束。提出部分分支定界（PBB）方法改进全分支定界（FBB）方法，以在复杂度-性能之间获得更好的权衡。对于高分辨率RIS的特殊情形，将离散相移集合近似为连续统，将原问题重构为斜流形上的约束优化问题，并提出基于二等分法的低复杂度求解算法。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提出的方法在不同SEP要求下能有效最小化发射功率，并展现了功率效率与计算复杂度之间的良好平衡。

Conclusion: 本文提出的PBB方法和针对高分辨率RIS的斜流形二等分法在不同SEP要求下均能有效实现发射功率最小化，同时在功率效率与计算复杂度之间取得了合理的折中。

Abstract: This study investigates a virtual multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) system with PSK modulation, realized with a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-based transmitter. The study focuses on minimizing transmit power under quality-of-service (QoS) constraints while addressing the associated computational complexity. A discrete phase-shift RIS model is considered, and the power minimization problem is formulated in two scenarios. First, for QPSK user data, the symbol-error probability (SEP) is adopted as the QoS criterion. Second, for general $M$-PSK modulation, the union-bound SEP (UBSEP) is used to define the QoS constraints. Based on the considered formulations, a partial branch-and-bound (PBB) approach is developed, which improves on full branch-and-bound (FBB) methods in the sense of allowing for favorable complexity performance trade-offs. For the special case of high-resolution RIS, the discrete phase-shift set is approximated by its continuous counterpart, enabling the reformulation of the original problems as constrained optimizations on an oblique manifold, which are solved with reduced computational complexity with the proposed bisection method. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches in minimizing the transmit power for different SEP requirements and showcase the balance between power efficiency and computational complexity

</details>


### [340] [Structured-Sparsity-Aware Joint User Activity Detection and Channel Estimation for OTFS-Based Grant-Free Random Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03896)
*Yao Ge,Yirui Luo,Yuhao Chi,Yufei Zhao,Yong Liang Guan,David González G.,Zhi Ding*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于OTFS调制的免授权随机接入框架，利用延迟-多普勒信道的结构化稀疏性，通过双层因子图和结构化稀疏期望传播算法实现联合用户活动检测与信道估计，显著优于现有基准方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向未来无线网络中大规模机器类通信（mMTC）的免授权随机接入需求，尤其在高速移动场景下OTFS调制与GFRA结合时，可靠的用户活动检测与信道估计面临关键挑战。

Method: 采用基扩展模型（BEM）将联合用户活动检测与信道估计建模为结构化压缩感知问题；识别出跨多接收天线的公共稀疏性和跨mMTC用户的激活稀疏性构成的双层稀疏结构；据此构建双层因子图，并开发结构化稀疏期望传播（SS-EP）算法进行高效贝叶斯推断。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方案在性能上显著优于现有基准方法。

Conclusion: 基于OTFS的GFRA框架通过利用延迟-多普勒域的固有结构化稀疏性以及SS-EP算法的贝叶斯推断能力，能够有效实现高可靠性的用户活动检测与信道估计，是未来mMTC系统中前景广阔的技术方案。

Abstract: Grant-free random access (GFRA) is a promising solution for massive machine-type communications (mMTC) in future wireless networks. However, reliable user activity detection and channel estimation are critical challenges, particularly when orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) modulation is integrated with GFRA to address doubly selective channels induced by high mobility. In this paper, we propose an OTFS-based GFRA framework that exploits the inherent structured sparsity of delay-Doppler channels. By adopting a basis expansion model (BEM), we formulate joint user activity detection and channel estimation as a structured compressive sensing problem. A bi-level sparsity structure is identified, consisting of common sparsity across multiple receive antennas and activation sparsity across mMTC users. To effectively leverage this structure, we construct a two-layer factor graph and develop a structured sparsity expectation propagation (SS-EP) algorithm for efficient Bayesian inference. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme significantly outperforms existing benchmarks.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [341] [Quota and population monotonicity across house sizes are incompatible for apportionment to four states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02759)
*Lav R. Varshney*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了在允许比较的房屋规模不同的定义下，不存在同时满足配额约束（quota）和人口单调性（population monotonicity）的确定性四州分配方案，填补了此前三州可能性与五州不可能性之间的边界空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的不相容性结果依赖于序保持（order-preservation）等额外假设。Gölz、Peters和Procaccia通过五州构造移除了这些假设，同时三州的可能性结果已知，因此四州成为未解决的关键边界问题。本文旨在确定四州情形下这两条公理是否相容。

Method: 通过有限的逻辑构造（finite logical gadget）进行证明。在中心配置（central profile）做出一个配额选择后，构建十二个辅助配置（auxiliary profiles）来编码三个比特信息，从而强制形成一个受限循环（frustrated cycle），矛盾由此产生。论证仅依赖人口不变的州之间的转移，不需要匿名性、中性、序保持、同质性或其他正则性条件，并同样适用于相对人口单调性（relative population monotonicity）。

Result: 证明了在四州情形下，确定性分配方案无法同时满足配额约束和人口单调性（在其允许比较房屋规模不同的定义下）。这是全局性的兼容性障碍，本质上是配额约束下的格点取整（lattice rounding）的兼容性阻塞，而非平均失真边界。

Conclusion: 四州边界问题得到解决：三州可行、四州不可行、五州不可行，因此完整刻画了在这两条公理下确定性分配方案的存在性边界。

Abstract: Apportionment converts fractional entitlements into integer seat allocations. Quota requires each state to receive the floor or ceiling of its standard quota, whereas population monotonicity prohibits a state whose population weakly increases from losing a seat to a state whose population weakly decreases. Gölz, Peters, and Procaccia recently removed the order-preservation assumptions used in classical incompatibility results by giving a five-state construction; together with the three-state Webster possibility result, this left four states as the unresolved boundary. We prove that no deterministic four-state apportionment solution satisfies both axioms under their definition, which permits the compared house sizes to differ. The proof is a finite logical gadget. Conditional on one quota choice at a central profile, twelve auxiliary profiles encode three bits and force a frustrated cycle. The argument uses only transfers between states whose populations are unchanged and assumes neither anonymity, neutrality, order preservation, homogeneity, nor other regularity conditions. It also applies to relative population monotonicity. Geometrically, the result is a global compatibility obstruction for quota-constrained lattice rounding, rather than an average-distortion bound.

</details>


### [342] [EFX Allocation In (Multi)Hypergraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03171)
*Thanasis Lianeas,Alkmini Sgouritsa,Minas Marios Sotiriou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了不可分割物品在具有异质单调估值的智能体之间的公平分配问题，证明了围长至少为4的超图（以及满足特定多重性条件的多超图）上总是存在EFX分配，且可（伪）多项式时间内构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EFX分配的存在性即使是对于可加性估值的智能体也是公平分配领域的一个重大开放问题。Christodoulou等人(2023)引入了图设置来研究这一问题的特例，本文在此基础上进一步探索超图场景中的EFX分配存在性，期望在更一般的图结构上取得突破。

Method: 本文将图设置推广到超图设置：智能体和物品分别由超图的顶点和边表示，只有一条边的端点对该边可能有非零边际价值。对于围长至少为4的超图，本文证明了在一般单调估值下EFX分配总是存在且可以通过多项式时间算法构造。进一步地，本文将方法推广到多超图，要求简单超图围长至少为4，且存在一个顶点其关联边的重数至多为该边大小减2，此时用伪多项式时间算法构造EFX分配。

Result: 证明了对于围长至少为4的超图，一般单调估值下总是存在EFX分配且可多项式时间构造；对于满足上述多重性条件的多超图，EFX分配同样总是存在，但构造需要伪多项式时间。

Conclusion: 本文通过将公平分配问题与超图结构结合，在特定的图结构限制下取得了EFX分配存在性方面的新进展，为最终解决一般情形下EFX分配的存在性问题提供了重要的理论支撑和构造性方法。

Abstract: We study fair allocations of indivisible goods among agents with heterogeneous monotone valuations. As fair we consider the allocations that are envy-free-up-to-any-good (EFX). Finding if EFX alloca- tions always exist, even for agents with additive valuations, is a major open problem in Fair Division. Christodoulou et al. (2023) introduced the (multi-hyper)graph setting, where agents and goods are represented by vertices and edges of a graph, respectively, and only the endpoints of an edge may have non-zero marginal value for it. We show that for hypergraphs with girth at least 4 and agents with general monotone valuations there always exists an EFX allocation and can be constructed in polynomial time. We generalize our approach to also show that multi-hypergraphs with girth (on the simple hypergraph) at least 4 always admit an EFX allocation, as long as there exists a single vertex whose incident edges have multiplicity at most the size of that edge minus 2; our construction in this case needs pseudo-polynomial time.

</details>


### [343] [3 Players Auction Bridge - Statistical Algorithmic Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03217)
*Sourish Sarkar,Aritrabha Majumdar,Moutushi Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文针对三人拍卖桥牌游戏，利用统计学习方法分析动态搭档与对手关系带来的博弈特性，提出精确算法与对应的获胜策略，并通过模拟数据计算获胜概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统拍卖桥牌为四人游戏，存在一定的偏见且真实性受限。三人拍卖桥牌通过动态搭档和对手关系减少偏差、提升游戏真实性，但目前缺乏系统的算法与策略分析。

Method: 针对三人拍卖桥牌的不同场景开发精确算法及相应获胜策略，探索不同游戏规划中涉及的计算智能，并基于算法进行数据模拟，定义赢得特定游戏的概率值。

Result: 通过模拟数据得到了在特定游戏情境下获胜的概率值，验证了算法及策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 三人拍卖桥牌中的动态搭档与对手机制是可量化分析的，精确算法配合统计学习能够有效支撑该游戏的策略规划与获胜概率评估。

Abstract: Three-player auction bridge is an updated version of the worldwide-recognized auction bridge card game. Dynamic partners and opponents are the key factors in this game. This dynamic property reduces the bias and increases the authenticity of this game. The article provides insight on statistical learning and insight for a three-player auction bridge game. An exact algorithm for various scenarios is developed along with the corresponding winning strategies to explore different game plannings and the computational intelligence involved. Based on the algorithm, we simulate data and define the probabilistic values to win a certain game.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [344] [Deep Divide-and-Reduce in Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02628)
*Yusong Deng,Yanjie Li,Weijun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDRSR方法，通过数学推导扩展了符号回归中的表达式分解与化简机制，避免了AI Feynman方法中依赖暴力搜索子表达式的局限，兼顾更广的适用性与严格的理论正确性，实验验证其在表达式分解和数值回归任务上均有显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的符号回归(SR)机器学习方法往往缺乏对数学和物理内在原理的深刻理解。AI Feynman方法虽然利用了数据背后的数学性质，但其表达式化简机制适用范围狭窄，在复杂方程上容易失败，且依赖暴力搜索子表达式，严重限制了实际可用性。

Method: 通过严格的数学推导与证明，提出Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR)方法，从根本上拓宽表达式分解与化简的适用范围，规避暴力搜索子结构的需要，保证更广的通用性和严格的理论正确性。

Result: 经验评估表明，DDRSR所依据的理论原理在表达式分解和数值回归任务上均带来显著优势，证明了其有效性。

Conclusion: 文中还讨论了该范式的适用场景、固有局限性以及未来有前景的研究方向。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) is the task of discovering underlying patterns from data and representing them using mathematical expressions. Current machine learning approaches to SR often lack a profound understanding of the intrinsic mathematical and physical principles governing these expressions. While the pioneering AI Feynman method leverages the mathematical properties underlying the data, its expression simplification mechanism suffers from a narrow scope of applicability and is prone to failure on complex equations. Furthermore, its underlying mechanisms rely heavily on brute-force searches for sub-expressions, severely limiting its practical utility. Through rigorous mathematical deduction and proofs, we propose our method, Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR). DDRSR fundamentally broadens the applicability of expression decomposition and reduction, circumvents the need for brute-force sub-structure searches, and ensures both wider versatility and strict theoretical correctness. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that these theoretical principles yield significant advantages in both expression decomposition and numerical regression tasks. Finally, we discuss the applicable scenarios and inherent limitations of this paradigm, alongside promising directions for future research.

</details>


### [345] [Multimodal Auto-regressive Transformer Surrogate for Modeling Variable Operations and Quantifying Uncertainty in Geological Carbon Storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02629)
*Yifu Han,Louis J. Durlofsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态自回归Transformer代理模型，用于在地质不确定性下高效建模CO2地质封存操作（变射孔和注入策略）。模型融合3D地质模型、标量参数和控制变量三种模态，通过自注意力融合与自回归解码预测饱和度、压力等关键量，并在层次化MCMC数据同化中显著降低关键元参数（特别是断层渗透率）的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地质CO2封存操作中，可变井射孔和注入策略能提升作业效率，但需在地质不确定性下进行高效建模。传统全阶数值模拟（如GEOS流程模拟）计算成本高昂，难以支持不确定度量化与数据同化等需要大量前向评估的流程，因此需要开发高效且准确的代理模型。

Method: 构建一个多模态自回归Transformer代理模型：三个独立编码器分别处理3D地质模型、相对渗透率函数标量参数和控制变量三种输入模态；通过Transformer编码器中的自注意力进行模态融合；使用解码器通过编码器-解码器交叉注意力自回归地预测时间序列输出。模型基于4000次GEOS流动模拟训练，预测监测点的饱和度与压力、总注入和可移动CO2质量以及饱和度足迹。代理模型嵌入层次化马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）数据同化框架中应用。

Result: 在包含随机采样的地质模型和控制变量的新测试集上，代理模型达到中位饱和度MAE为0.028，其他目标量的中位相对误差为0.2%-5%，并能捕获从速率控制到井底压力控制的切换。在合成真实模型下进行三种操作策略的层次化MCMC数据同化，关键元参数（特别是断层渗透率）的不确定性获得显著降低，后验预测的饱和度足迹与CO2质量与真实结果总体一致。

Conclusion: 该多模态自回归Transformer代理模型能在地质不确定性下高效准确地模拟变射孔/注入策略下的CO2封存过程，并可作为数据同化框架中的有效前向模型，实现关键地质参数（尤其是断层渗透率）的不确定性大幅缩减，为地质CO2封存操作优化与风险管理提供有力工具。

Abstract: The use of variable well perforation and injection strategies can improve the efficiency of geological carbon storage operations. We develop a new multimodal auto-regressive transformer surrogate to model these operations under geological uncertainty. A modified SEAM CO2 geomodel, which involves a faulted system with three stacked aquifers, is considered. The two injection wells are perforated in stages, from bottom to top, with the stage durations and individual well injection rates treated as control variables. The surrogate model processes three input modalities - the 3D geomodel, scalar parameters characterizing relative permeability functions, and control variables - through separate encoders. These are fused via self-attention in a transformer encoder, and a temporal decoder generates predictions auto-regressively through encoder-decoder cross-attention. The surrogate is trained, using 4000 GEOS flow simulations, to predict saturation and pressure at monitoring locations, total injected and mobile CO2 mass, and saturation footprints. For a new test set, involving randomly sampled geomodels and control variables, the surrogate achieves a median saturation MAE of 0.028 and median relative errors of 0.2-5% for the other quantities of interest. Importantly, it captures the switch from rate to bottom-hole-pressure control. The surrogate model is used within a hierarchical Markov chain Monte Carlo data assimilation procedure for a synthetic true model under three operational strategies. Substantial uncertainty reduction is achieved for key metaparameters, particularly the fault permeabilities. Posterior predictions for saturation footprints and total injected and mobile CO2 mass are also shown to be generally consistent with true model results.

</details>


### [346] [LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02632)
*Ameen Patel,Max Zhang,Nathan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化电路追踪的流水线，通过让语言模型直接对特征描述进行分组来生成supernodes，并验证其可解释性与人工标注相当，在两跳Capitals任务中97/100恢复中间跳对应的supernode，同时在Wikipedia提示词完成任务的1000个归因图上展示了开放探索的概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路追踪是揭示语言模型内部计算的重要技术，但传统方法需要耗费大量时间人工将个体特征或MLP神经元分组为supernodes。这一手动步骤严重限制了电路追踪的可扩展性，亟需自动化方案。

Method: 提出一个简单流水线：将特征描述直接呈现给语言模型，由模型将其分组为supernodes。利用自动化可解释性指标评估生成supernodes的质量，并通过一个两跳Capitals任务验证流水线的有效性，最后在1000个Wikipedia归因图上进行开放探索的自动标注，使用LLM法官筛选值得人工审查的图。

Result: 自动化supernodes的可解释性与人工标注相当；在1000个Wikipedia归因图上实验；在两跳Capitals任务中，97/100个提示词成功恢复出对应中间跳的supernode。

Conclusion: 即使简单的自动化方法也能产生有意义的归因图标注，这证明了自动化电路追踪的可行性，并激励了该方向的进一步研究。

Abstract: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by human annotators. On a two-hop Capitals task, our pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 of 100 prompts. Finally, we present a simple proof of concept using our pipeline for open-ended exploration, where we automatically annotate 1000 attribution graphs from Wikipedia prompt completions and then use an LLM judge to flag interesting graphs worth human review. We hope this work demonstrates that even simple automation can produce meaningful attribution graph annotations, motivating further work on automated circuit tracing.

</details>


### [347] [GeoID-PINN: Identifiability-Aware Regional Epidemic Inference with Geographic Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02633)
*Weixiong Hua,Fan Bu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoID-PINN，一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的SIRD动力学模型，通过行随机源组合矩阵表示区域间空间依赖，并利用距离、邻接、通勤或领先-滞后等先验信息进行正则化。模拟与真实COVID-19数据实验表明，轨迹拟合良好与依赖结构恢复之间不对等，且先验选择对推断结果有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域监测数据混杂了本地传播、报告、播种及外部感染压力等多重因素，难以单独识别。现有方法缺乏对区域间依赖结构的有效建模和约束，需要一种既能拟合疾病传播轨迹又能恢复区域依赖结构的方法。

Method: 提出GeoID-PINN，将空间依赖建模为行随机源组合矩阵（每行非负且和为1），并通过空间先验（距离、邻接、通勤或领先-滞后信息）对该矩阵进行正则化。采用SIRD动力学的物理信息神经网络框架，在模拟场景中验证先验兼容性的影响，并在路易斯安那州64个县的COVID-19数据上进行回顾性评估。

Result: 四区域模拟中，兼容距离先验的源组合误差为0.099，无正则化时为0.159，强误设先验时为0.577，但轨迹拟合和传播规模估计保持相似。64县COVID-19数据上，与自回归负二项基线相比，MSE从32,957降至11,468，MAE从70.60降至57.73，但基线NLL更低（5.158 vs 5.346）。15县对比中，县级邻接先验使MSE降低6.85%、MAE降低3.1%。

Conclusion: 精确的轨迹拟合不能保证区域依赖结构的正确恢复；结构化正则化有助于改善推断，但在不同合理先验下表现相似，无法实现唯一的边恢复。在应用前需要进行先验敏感性和观测模型检验。

Abstract: Regional surveillance data reflect local transmission, reporting, seeding, and external infection pressure, which are difficult to identify separately. We introduce GeoID-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for susceptible-infectious-recovered-deceased (SIRD) dynamics. The model represents spatial dependence with a row-stochastic source-composition matrix whose rows assign nonnegative source weights that sum to one. We regularize this matrix toward a spatial prior constructed from distance, adjacency, commuting, or lead-lag information. In a four-region simulation with known truth, a compatible distance prior gives source-composition error 0.099. The error rises to 0.159 without regularization and 0.577 under a strongly misspecified prior, while trajectory fit and transmission-scale estimates remain similar. Accurate trajectories therefore do not guarantee recovery of the regional dependence structure. We also evaluate GeoID-PINN retrospectively using COVID-19 data from 64 Louisiana counties. Relative to an autoregressive negative-binomial baseline, Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN reduces mean squared error (MSE) from 32,957 to 11,468 and mean absolute error (MAE) from 70.60 to 57.73. The baseline has lower negative log likelihood (NLL), 5.158 versus 5.346, indicating better distributional fit but worse point accuracy. In a controlled 15-county comparison, county adjacency reduces MSE by 6.85 percent and MAE by 3.1 percent. Similar performance across plausible priors supports structured regularization but not unique edge recovery. These results require prior-sensitivity and observation-model checks before interpretation.

</details>


### [348] [Verifier-Guided Model Discovery for Physical Dynamical Systems with Pretrained Symbolic Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02662)
*Farbod Faraji,Francesco Belardinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种验证器引导（VG）的神经到符号工作流，以ODEFormer为符号骨干，通过动力学和物理可接受性标准从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选方程，实现从合成ODE轨迹到高维物理数据的可靠迁移预测。在Van der Pol振子和涡脱落现象上验证了其有效性，实现了可解释且物理可审计的符号方程发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真物理仿真成本高昂，机器学习代理模型不透明且依赖系统动力学假设，泛化能力受限。预训练的transformer虽然能将合成ODE轨迹映射为符号方程，但如何可靠地将其迁移到高维物理数据仍是未解决的挑战。

Method: 开发了一个验证器引导（VG）工作流，以ODEFormer作为符号发现骨干，利用动力学和物理可接受性标准从多轨迹候选方程池中进行筛选。对涡脱落现象采用坐标约简（coordinate reduction）后进行符号发现，分别在固定和变化的雷诺数下进行实验，无需预设唤醒特定的候选库或Navier-Stokes结构。

Result: 在Van der Pol振子中，VG在未见过的初始条件下优于原始ODEFormer工作流。在涡脱落任务中，VG发现固定参数的约简阶方程能够恢复基本脱落振荡器及其高次谐波，跨参数模型可泛化到保留的雷诺数区间。此外，仅基于重构保真度无法决定符号可发现性，揭示了潜在动力学与骨干预训练分布之间的兼容性至关重要。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了验证器引导的神经到符号方法学，为自然科学中可解释、物理可审计的预测提供了新途径，并强调了符号可发现性不仅取决于数据重构质量，还取决于潜在动力学与预训练模型的匹配度。

Abstract: Reliable forecasting of nonlinear physical systems underpins scientific discovery and engineering decision-making. Yet high-fidelity simulations are prohibitively costly, and machine-learning surrogates can be opaque and encode assumptions about system dynamics, limiting generalizability. Pretrained transformers mapping synthetic ODE trajectories to equations offer interpretable alternatives, promising transfer without system-specific equation knowledge. Transferring them reliably to high-dimensional physical data, however, remains an open challenge. We develop a verifier-guided (VG) workflow around ODEFormer as a symbolic backbone, using dynamical and physical-admissibility criteria to select from a multi-trajectory candidate equation pool, enabling transfer. On canonical Van der Pol oscillators, VG outperforms the original ODEFormer workflow across held-out initial conditions. We then address vortex shedding, a phenomenon occurring in atmospheric and plasma systems of societal relevance, through coordinate reduction and symbolic discovery at fixed and varying Reynolds numbers. VG discovers fixed-parameter reduced-order equations that recover the fundamental shedding oscillator and higher harmonics without a wake-specific candidate library or prescribed Navier-Stokes structure, while the cross-parameter model generalizes to withheld regimes. Reconstruction fidelity alone did not determine symbolic discoverability, highlighting the importance of compatibility between latent dynamics and the backbone's pretraining distribution. This work establishes a verifier-guided neural-to-symbolic methodology for interpretable and physically auditable forecasting in the natural sciences.

</details>


### [349] [Amortized Interventional Forecasting for Multivariate CIR Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03715)
*Andreas Sauter,Sumit Sourabh,Drona Kandhai,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CIR-ACTIVA，一种用于多变量CIR过程分布因果效应估计的摊销模型，能够在不重新训练的情况下预测多时域冲击响应，并以CDS利差为测试平台验证其因果选择性和校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIR过程虽广泛用于金融时间序列建模，但只能捕捉序列间的相关共动，无法回答外部冲击下的因果响应问题。观测条件分布混杂了历史共动信息，无法进行真正的因果推断，因此需要一种能够估计分布因果效应的框架。

Method: 首先提出一种摊销模型，将轨迹视为时间戳观测，预测校准的多时域冲击响应而无需按场景重新训练；其次构建一个因果多变量CIR数据生成过程，提供真实市场无法提供的配对观测与干预真值；最后在CDS利差上进行实例化与校准。

Result: 在合成真值上验证了CIR-ACTIVA的有效性，在联合分布的因果选择性和时域分辨率校准上优于观测方法和摊销因果推理基线，且当干预法则随时域变化时仍保持选择性，收益集中在短时域。

Conclusion: 该框架开辟了一类耦合利差系统上的what-if查询（如CDS压力测试），这是传统观测预测器无法回答的，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Mean-reverting dynamics are pervasive in finance, and the Cox--Ingersoll--Ross (CIR) process is a standard model for the time series they produce, from short rates to credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Yet CIR models capture only \emph{correlated} co-movement, not \emph{causal} influence between series, so they cannot answer the system's response when one series is externally shocked, which observational conditionals confound with historical co-movement. We make two contributions. First, an amortized model for distributional causal effect estimation that frames trajectories as time-stamped observations and predicts the calibrated multi-horizon shock response without retraining per scenario. Second, a causal multivariate CIR data-generating process that supplies the paired observational and interventional ground truth that real markets cannot. We instantiate and calibrate the framework on CDS spreads as a testbed. CIR-ACTIVA's validity is established on synthetic ground truth, independent of how well the simulator matches reality, while practical grounding is assessed by backtesting the generated traces against real CDS data. Against observational and amortized causal-inference baselines, CIR-ACTIVA leads on both causal selectivity in the joint distribution and horizon-resolved calibration, retaining its selectivity once the interventional law varies over the horizon, with gains concentrating at short horizons. This opens up a class of what-if queries on coupled spread systems, CDS stress testing among them, that observational forecasters cannot answer.

</details>


### [350] [CT-HEG: A Bidirectional, Timestamp-Attributed Event Graph for ICU In-Hospital Mortality Prediction - An Architectural Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02663)
*Mohammad Nasir Uddin,Rahnuma Tabassum Orpita,Asaduzzaman Anik,Eklachur Rahman Bhuiyan,Marjahan Risalat,SM Wali Ullah,Asif Ahamed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CT-HEG（连续时间异质电子健康记录图谱）模式，将ICU住院数据编码为带类型的时序图（节点：visit、vital、lab_event），边带有小时/48时间戳和归一化值作为二维特征。基于此构建CHIRP-Net（四层异质GATv2Conv网络），在MIMIC-IV v3.1上（31,142次ICU住院，13.4%死亡率）达到5种子平均AUROC 0.8449，集成后AUROC 0.8618，校准后ECE 0.0307。关键发现：双向连接至关重要（去除后AUROC下降0.1968），时间注意力边缘特征贡献0.0247 AUROC，但将异质边类型折叠为单一关系反而在全部分种子上表现更优且参数减少7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型存在两难：序列模型能处理不规则采样但忽略类型化的关系结构，而图模型通常假设固定间隔输入。作者旨在弥合这一差距，引入一种同时兼顾不规则时序建模与异质实体类型关系的ICU死亡率预测模式，并系统评估哪些架构选择真正驱动预测性能。

Method: CT-HEG将每次ICU住院编码为带类型的带时间戳图，包含三类节点（visit、vital、lab_event），边带有二维属性（t_hours/48时间归一化和value_norm值归一化），无需插补。模型CHIRP-Net为四层异质GATv2Conv网络。在MIMIC-IV v3.1上评估，使用五个随机种子和自助法置信区间，与逻辑回归、mTAND、Transformer和GRU-D对比，并进行了消融实验（去除反向边、去除时间注意力特征、折叠异质边类型）。

Result: CHIRP-Net 5种子平均AUROC为0.8449±0.0071（AUPRC 0.4958±0.0209），集成交到AUROC 0.8618（95%CI: 0.8485-0.8745）。去除反向边后AUROC下降0.1968±0.0073（说明双向连接对模型有效利用输入至关重要）；时间注意力边缘特征贡献0.0247±0.0093 AUROC；折叠边类型为单一关系虽减少7倍参数但全种子表现更优。校准后ECE为0.0307。

Conclusion: CT-HEG模式适用于不规则EHR数据的ICU死亡率预测，验证集拟合的温度缩放后校准良好。然而作者明确指出，外部验证、预先指定的时序评估和人口统计学公平性审计仍是必需的，目前不能声称模型的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Accurate ICU mortality prediction requires modeling irregular clinical observations across heterogeneous entity types. Existing sequence models handle irregular sampling but ignore typed relational structure; existing graph models assume fixed-interval inputs. We introduce the Continuous-Time Heterogeneous EHR Graph (CT-HEG) schema and evaluate which architectural choices drive predictive performance. CT-HEG encodes each ICU stay as a typed, timestamped graph with three node types (visit, vital, lab_event) and 2D edge attributes (t_hours/48, value_norm) encoding timing and value without imputation. We instantiate CT-HEG as CHIRP-Net, a four-layer heterogeneous GATv2Conv network, evaluated on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (31,142 ICU stays, LOS>=48h, 13.4% mortality) with five seeds and bootstrapped confidence intervals, against logistic regression, mTAND, a Transformer, and GRU-D, plus an ablation study. CHIRP-Net achieved 5-seed mean AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071 (AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209); the ensemble achieved AUROC 0.8618 (95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745). Removing reverse edges disconnected observation nodes from the visit readout, cutting AUROC by 0.1968+/-0.0073. Time-attentive edge features contributed 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC. Collapsing heterogeneous edge types into one relation (7x fewer parameters) outperformed the full model on all seeds. Post-calibration ECE was 0.0307. Temporal and demographic subgroup analyses were explored but not reported here, pending follow-up work. Bidirectional connectivity was necessary for the model to use its inputs at all, and CT-HEG was reasonably well calibrated after validation-fitted temperature scaling. These results support CT-HEG for irregular EHR data, while external validation, a pre-specified temporal evaluation, and a demographic fairness audit remain necessary before any claim of robustness. Code: https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv.

</details>


### [351] [Sphere Retraction Normalizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02668)
*Jie Zhang,Cheng-Fang Su,Yi-Jui Huang,Min-Te Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出p-SpheretNorm，将残差连接在超球面上的处理统一为一个标量设计选择——旋转角度如何从更新幅度转换而来。通过指数映射（GeoNorm）和恒等映射（Euclidean残差）作为两个极限端，在有限p值处取得最优性能，表明指数映射并非球面残差流的最佳选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GeoNorm通过黎曼指数映射将残差流限制在超球面上，但指数映射只是众多retraction映射中的一种。作者希望探索整个retraction族，并统一Euclidean残差连接与GeoNorm在同一个框架下。

Method: 在超球面上证明了整个retraction族坍缩为单一标量设计选择：区别仅在于如何将更新幅度转换为隐藏状态与更新张成平面内的旋转角度。由此提出p-SpheretNorm，一个单参数的角度retraction族，其中旋转角度饱和而非无界增长。metric projection和Cayley retraction分别对应p=1和p=2，恒等映射和GeoNorm在两个端点作为极限出现。

Result: 在nanoGPT上，三种方法均超越现有轻量级深层连接方案；最佳验证损失出现在有限p值处，表明指数映射不是球面残差流的最优retraction选择。

Conclusion: 球面残差流的最优retraction并非GeoNorm所采用的指数映射，而是位于恒等映射与指数映射之间有限p值处的某种角度饱和retraction。Euclidean残差与GeoNorm可以统一在单一框架中。

Abstract: Residual connections are the de facto mechanism for training deep neural networks stably. Geodesic Normalization (GeoNorm) recasts them on a Riemannian manifold, orthogonalizing each layer output against the current hidden state and applying the resulting update through the Riemannian exponential map. Every hidden state thus keeps a constant $\ell_{2}$-norm, confining the residual stream to a hypersphere. The exponential map, however, is only one member of a broad family of retraction maps. We show that on the hypersphere this entire family collapses to a single scalar design choice. What distinguishes one retraction from another is only how the magnitude of an update is converted into a rotation angle within the plane spanned by the hidden state and the update. This view places Euclidean residual connections and GeoNorm in one framework. Instantiating it with the metric projection retraction and the Cayley retraction yields Proj-SpheretNorm and Cay-SpheretNorm, which are exactly norm-preserving yet require only algebraic operations. Both prove to be members of a one-parameter family of angular retractions, $p$-SpheretNorm, whose rotation angle saturates rather than growing without bound. The two methods above are recovered exactly at $p = 1$ and $p = 2$, while the identity map and GeoNorm arise only as limits at either end. On nanoGPT, all three methods outperform existing lightweight deep connection schemes, and the best validation loss is attained at finite $p$, indicating that the exponential map is not the preferred retraction for spherical residual streams but merely one end of a spectrum.

</details>


### [352] [Learning Molecular Representations from Cellular Phenotypes with Structure Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02688)
*Xuan Lin,Jingyu Sheng,Tengfei Ma,Li Sun,Dapeng Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PhenMol框架，一种结构保持的表型感知分子表示学习方法，通过解耦分子和细胞表征为共享与私有组件，在表型引导对齐的同时保留化学结构信息，在约3.04万分子-细胞形态对上取得了优于现有多模态对齐方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表型药物发现中的多模态表示学习方法通常只优化跨模态对齐，忽略了化学空间的固有组织（分子邻域结构），导致分子表示发生扭曲并丢失结构信息。

Method: PhenMol将分子和细胞表示解耦为共享组件和私有组件，通过专门的分子分支进行表型引导对齐，同时保留分子邻域组织（化学结构信息），实现结构保持的表型感知分子表示学习。

Result: 在约3.04×10^4分子-细胞形态对上进行实验，PhenMol在270个生物活性任务的分子性质预测、分子-表型检索和临床试验结局预测方面均有提升；ECFP4结构分析表明其更好保持了分子邻域并降低了嵌入扭曲。

Conclusion: 多模态分子表示学习中结构感知约束至关重要，该工作为将细胞表型与化学知识整合用于药物发现提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery enables the discovery of functional relationships between molecular structures and cellular responses. However, existing multimodal representation learning methods often optimize cross-modal alignment without considering the intrinsic organization of chemical space, resulting in distorted molecular representations and loss of structural information. We propose \textbf{PhenMol}, a structure-preserving framework for phenotype-aware molecular representation learning. PhenMol disentangles molecular and cellular representations into shared and private components, enabling phenotype-guided alignment while preserving chemical structures through a dedicated molecular branch. This design integrates cellular phenotype information without disrupting molecular neighborhood organization. Experiments on approximately $3.04 \times 10^{4}$ molecule--cell morphology pairs demonstrate that PhenMol improves molecular property prediction across 270 bioactivity tasks, molecule--phenotype retrieval, and clinical trial outcome prediction. Moreover, ECFP4-based structural analysis shows that PhenMol better preserves molecular neighborhoods and reduces embedding distortion compared with existing multimodal alignment methods. These results highlight the importance of structure-aware constraints in multimodal molecular representation learning and provide an effective approach for integrating cellular phenotypes with chemical knowledge for drug discovery.

</details>


### [353] [GLOBE: Trajectory-Aligned Gradient Matching with Structured SparseOptimization for Coreset Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02690)
*Hetian Liu,Jin Cui,Mengcheng Shi,Yanbin Hu,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Pen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLOBE是一个面向设备端训练的核心集选择框架，通过多检查点梯度轨迹表示每个样本，结合多阶分布匹配目标与结构化稀疏正则化，将样本选择形式化为全局优化的稀疏加权问题，在六个基准和五个架构上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设备端深度神经网络训练受限于大规模数据集的计算和内存成本。现有基于梯度的核心集选择方法通常在单一模型快照上计算梯度，并使用贪心或追踪式选择过程，无法捕捉训练过程中动态变化的优化轨迹，也难以处理强相关的样本。这限制了核心集选择的性能和适用性。

Method: GLOBE通过三个关键设计实现：(1) 轨迹对齐表示——使用多个训练检查点构建每个样本的梯度轨迹，捕捉其在整个优化不同阶段的影响；(2) 多阶匹配目标——联合对齐梯度轨迹的一阶均值与投影非中心二阶矩，以保持全量数据集的训练行为；(3) 结构化稀疏优化——结合Group LASSO、Elastic Net正则化和非负预算约束，诱导组级与样本级稀疏性并稳定相关轨迹的权重；最后采用类均衡Top-K选择确保在有限预算下保持类别覆盖。

Result: 在六个基准数据集和五个评估架构上的实验表明，GLOBE在下游测试准确率上持续优于现有核心集选择方法，尤其在低保留比例（小样本预算）下优势更为显著。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了将动态梯度信息、多阶分布匹配与结构化稀疏性相结合进行数据高效学习的有效性，为设备端核心集选择提供了新的方法论方向。

Abstract: On-device training of deep neural networks is fundamentally constrained by the computational and memory costs of large-scale datasets. Coreset selection offers a practical solution by retaining only a compact subset of real training samples. However, existing gradient-based methods commonly rely on gradients computed at a single model snapshot and employ greedy or pursuit-based selection procedures, limiting their ability to capture evolving optimization dynamics and handle strongly correlated samples. We propose GLOBE (Gradient Local-Balanced Extraction), a trajectory-aligned coreset selection framework that formulates sample selection as a globally optimized sparse weighting problem. GLOBE represents each sample by a gradient trajectory constructed across multiple training checkpoints, thereby capturing its influence throughout different stages of optimization. To preserve the training behavior of the full dataset, we introduce a multi-order matching objective that jointly aligns the first-order mean and projected uncentered second-order moments of gradient trajectories. GLOBE further combines Group LASSO, Elastic Net regularization, and nonnegative budget constraints to induce group- and sample-level sparsity while stabilizing the weights of correlated trajectories. Finally, class-balanced Top-K selection maintains adequate category coverage under limited sampling budgets. Experiments across six benchmarks and five evaluation architectures demonstrate that GLOBE consistently outperforms existing coreset selection methods in downstream test accuracy, particularly at low retention ratios. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining dynamic gradient information, multi-order distribution matching, and structured sparsity for data-efficient learning.

</details>


### [354] [Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02691)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Woosang Lim,Minsoo Cheong,Sunwoo Lee,Murali Annavaram,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OptR是一种输出感知的旋转方法，用于长上下文大语言模型推理中的INT2 KV缓存量化。它通过最小化经过输出投影W_O后的注意力输出误差，将误差分解为键相关和值相关项，并学习逐头正交校正，同时通过注意力等价的键重参数化减少大的通道偏移，在不改变softmax分布的情况下提升量化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于旋转的INT2方法在完整的注意力读出之前优化缓存统计量或代理误差，但模型最终实际受到的是经过注意力和输出投影W_O传播后的误差影响。这种优化目标与实际影响之间的不匹配导致了量化性能次优。

Method: OptR将经过W_O之后的注意力输出误差分解为键诱导项和值诱导项，通过完整的INT2量化和注意力路径学习逐头正交校正；同时应用注意力等价的键重参数化来减少大的通道偏移，且不改变softmax分布，并保持分页KV缓存格式。

Result: 在三个模型和五个推理及编码基准上，OptR一致性地提升了QuaRot和OSCAR两种基线方法，并增强了长上下文检索能力，同时以可忽略的推理开销保持了分页KV缓存格式。

Conclusion: OptR通过直接对经过输出投影后的注意力输出误差进行优化，弥补了现有INT2量化方法中优化目标与实际影响之间的错配，为超低位KV缓存量化提供了更有效的解决方案。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.

</details>


### [355] [PatTree: a novel approach for automated creation of multimodal, graph-based patient representations for medical classification tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02692)
*Julia Gehrmann,Lars Quakulinski,Hamza Naseem,Oya Beyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PatTree，一种基于图的、从真实世界临床数据自动构建的全方位患者表示方法，能够在不依赖预标准化输入的情况下实现多模态临床数据的早期集成。在ADNI-1子集（n=763）上，PatTree在阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍和认知正常的三分类任务中达到98.5%的平衡准确率和0.987的F1分数，证明无需假设的自动化多模态数据结构化可作为临床AI管道的可扩展基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床真实世界数据具有异构性和复杂性（缺失值、多时间点、多模态、格式和语义不一致），传统数据标准化（数据协调）过程资源密集且易出错，限制了多模态AI驱动的临床决策支持的可扩展性和可重复性。作者希望绕过繁琐的数据准备步骤，直接实现多模态临床数据的自动化结构化与集成。

Method: 提出了PatTree，一个基于图的、全面的患者表示框架。该方法从真实世界临床数据中自动结构化多模态临床数据，将异构临床数据统一表示为知识图谱，保留跨模态和数据源间数据元素的语义关系，支持互操作性和机器可解释的数据访问，不需要依赖预标准化的输入数据。

Result: 在ADNI-1队列子集（n=763）上，直接在PatTree上进行三分类任务（区分阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍和认知正常个体），在留出测试集上达到98.5%的平衡准确率和0.987的F1分数，达到最先进的分类性能。

Conclusion: 无需假设的自动化多模态医疗数据结构化可以绕过繁琐的数据准备和标准化过程，作为临床AI管道的可扩展基础。PatTree证明了图表示的早期数据集成策略在真实世界临床数据上的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Access to holistic, multimodal data improves the performance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in medical classification tasks compared to utilizing single modalities or data sources. However, the inherent heterogeneity and complexity of clinical real-world data pose significant challenges to structured data analysis and AI application. This heterogeneity includes missing values, multiple time points, diverse modalities, and inconsistent formats and semantics. Data harmonization prior to data integration tackles this challenge but remains resource-intensive and error-prone, limiting the scalability and reproducibility of holistic, AI-driven decision support on clinical real-world data. We therefore propose PatTree, a graph-based, holistic representation of patients that can be derived from real-world clinical data through the automated structuring of multimodal clinical data. PatTree enables early-stage data integration without relying on pre-standardized inputs. While representing heterogeneous clinical data within a unified knowledge graph, PatTree preserves the semantic relationships between data elements across modalities and data sources, facilitating interoperability and machine-interpretable data access. Using a subset of the ADNI-1 cohort (n = 763), we demonstrate that classification of patients is directly feasible on PatTree reaching state-of-the-art classification performance. In the three-class classification task distinguishing Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and cognitively normal individuals, we achieve a balanced accuracy of 98.5% and an F$_1$ score of 0.987 on the held-out test set. Our results show that assumption-free, automated structuring of multimodal medical data can serve as a scalable foundation for clinical AI pipelines bypassing tedious data preparation and standardization.

</details>


### [356] [Measuring Explainer Stability via Attribution Separability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02697)
*Eddie Conti,Álvaro Parafita,Axel Brando*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分布的框架来量化归因方法（AMs）的稳定性，通过分析排序归因向量的可分性，确定特征排序保持可靠的最大索引，并将该框架扩展到跨数据集比较不同AMs的排序鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归因方法广泛用于解释黑盒模型，但由于定义中存在的随机组件，大多数方法会产生可变的归因分数，导致解释结果不够稳定。现有方法缺乏对归因分数稳定性的系统性度量。

Method: 提出基于分布的框架：1) 理解排序归因向量中可分性程度，获取特征排序保持可靠的最大索引；2) 扩展框架以跨数据集比较不同归因方法的排序鲁棒性。

Result: 通过实验展示了如何应用该方法评估解释器的稳定性，表明该框架可作为评价归因方法稳定性的补充准则。

Conclusion: 该分布框架为评估归因方法的稳定性提供了一种补充性判据，有助于更全面地理解和选择适合的归因解释方法。

Abstract: Attribution methods (AMs) assign an importance score to each feature and are widely adopted to explain black-box models. However, most methods can produce variable attribution scores due to stochastic components in their definition. In this paper, we propose a distribution-based framework to capture the stability of attribution scores. In particular, our approach allows to understand the degree of separability in the ranked attribution vector and obtain the largest index for which a feature ranking remains reliable. We further extend this framework to compare AMs based on the robustness of their rankings across a dataset. Through experiments, we demonstrate how to apply our method to evaluate explainer stability. Overall, our approach provides a complementary criterion for evaluating the stability of AMs.

</details>


### [357] [NANQ: Noise-Floor-Aware Mixed-Precision Non-Uniform Quantization for Analog Compute-in-Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02700)
*Yizhe Chen,Wenshuai Yao,Saiya Wang,Yuannuo Feng,Wenbo Qi,Kechao Tang,Ngai Wong,Wenyong Zhou,Wang Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NANQ，一个针对模拟存算一体（CIM）芯片的噪声感知混合精度非均匀量化框架，通过建模eFlash CIM阵列的幅值相关权值噪声并将其转换为自适应量化密度，在2-bit量化下显著提升视觉模型精度和语言模型困惑度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟存算一体芯片虽能实现高能效神经网络推理，但器件变异和读取噪声会严重退化低比特量化模型的性能。现有面向CIM的量化方法主要最小化理想量化误差，忽略了硬件噪声底限，导致精度分配效率低下。

Method: NANQ首先从eFlash CIM阵列的实测响应中建模幅值相关的权值噪声，将噪声分布转化为自适应的量化密度——在低噪声区域分配更细的量化分辨率，在噪声主导区域避免无效精度分配。其次，通过统一的阈值识别每层在硬件噪声下的精度饱和点，据此分配逐层比特宽度。

Result: 在eFlash CIM SoC上进行的芯片内实验表明，在2-bit权值幅值量化下，NANQ相比PowerQuant在视觉模型上平均提升8.05个百分点准确率，在语言模型上平均降低54.7%的困惑度。混合精度NANQ仅用3.2-3.8等效比特即可获得额外量化资源的大部分收益。

Conclusion: 噪声感知的量化策略能有效匹配硬件噪声分布，在设计低比特量化方案时需要考虑硬件噪声底限而非仅关注理想量化误差，从而在有限比特预算下实现更优的精度-能效权衡。

Abstract: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) enables energy-efficient neural network inference, but device variation and read noise can severely degrade low-bit quantized models. Existing CIM-oriented quantization methods mainly minimize ideal quantization error, ignoring the hardware noise floor and thus causing inefficient precision allocation. We propose NANQ, a noise-aware mixed-precision non-uniform quantization framework for analog CIM. NANQ models magnitude-dependent weight noise from measured responses of an eFlash CIM array and converts the noise profile into an adaptive quantization density, assigning finer resolution to low-noise regions while avoiding ineffective precision in noise-dominated regions. It further assigns layer-wise bit-widths by identifying each layer's precision saturation point under hardware noise using a unified threshold. On-chip experiments on an eFlash CIM SoC show that, under 2-bit weight-magnitude quantization, NANQ improves vision-model accuracy by 8.05 percentage points and reduces language-model PPL by 54.7% on average over PowerQuant. Mixed-precision NANQ captures most of the gains obtainable from additional quantization resources with only 3.2-3.8 equivalent bits.

</details>


### [358] [Can Training Logs Make Model Comparisons More Precise?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02705)
*Wei-Jung Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用训练日志中的协变量来更精确地比较随机训练的模型。通过仅使用各模型自身运行产生的统计量进行分组（arm-specific）协变量调整，视觉任务上的三架构三数据集实验表明，基于早期训练日志的简单调整通常能降低模型比较的不确定性，但广泛的协变量搜索会引入过多选择噪声，反而降低精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较随机训练的模型时，需要从多次运行中同时估计性能差异及其不确定性。现有方法忽视了训练日志这一在训练过程中自然产生、可能携带有用信息的协变量来源，作者希望探索这些日志能否使模型比较更精确。

Method: 采用arm-specific协变量调整方法：每个模型仅用其自身运行产生的统计量进行校正，将未经调整的原始均值差异保持为最终报告效应。在三种架构和三个数据集上进行视觉任务实验，比较基于早期训练日志的简单调整与广泛搜索最相关统计量的调整策略。

Result: 基于早期训练日志的简单调整通常能降低模型比较的方差/不确定性；但广泛搜索日志池中最相关统计量的做法往往引入更多噪声而非消除噪声，即便存在事后看来有用的统计量也是如此。

Conclusion: 训练日志可用于提高模型比较的精度，但前提是调整过程需避免大规模协变量搜索带来的选择噪声。协变量选择是该方法的主要局限性。

Abstract: Comparing stochastically trained models requires estimating both a performance difference and its uncertainty from repeated runs. We study whether training logs from those same runs can make such comparisons more precise. Because training-log covariates are produced during training rather than measured before it, we use arm-specific covariate adjustment: each model is adjusted only with statistics from its own runs, and the raw mean difference remains the reported effect. In a vision study spanning three architectures and three datasets, simple adjustments based on early training logs often reduce uncertainty in model comparisons. The main limitation is covariate selection. Broadly searching the log pool for the most correlated statistic often adds more noise than it removes, even when useful statistics exist in hindsight. Training logs therefore appear useful for more precise model comparisons, but only when the adjustment avoids large selection noise.

</details>


### [359] [Designing a Good Virtual Node: Addressable and Cardinality-Preserving Global Memory for Message Passing Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02709)
*Félix Marcoccia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可寻址且保持基数不变的虚拟内存机制，通过将全局内存分解为独立可写可读的状态，并为每个slot查询插入私有键/值锚点来恢复softmax归一化丢弃的权重，从而缓解消息传递神经网络中虚拟节点压缩通道的有限容量瓶颈，在O(nMd)的算术代价下支持多重集注入式表示并实现1-WL精化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的虚拟节点-节点-虚拟节点通道将整个图压缩为单一同质状态并同等地广播给所有节点，存在有限容量瓶颈。作者希望在无自注意力的条件下，通过辅助虚拟内存来缓解这一瓶颈，使全局通信保留多重性信息。

Method: 基于Two-Radius分析，提出两个核心要求：(1) 全局内存应分解为独立可写可读的状态，通过可寻址的交叉注意力槽实现；(2) 仅靠可寻址性不够，因为softmax注意力对均匀复制具有不变性，会丢失多重性信息。解决方法是：将每个槽查询作为私有键/值锚点插入，恢复被丢弃的归一化质量，从而在有限颜色域上获得注入式多重集表示，能够实现1-WL精化。

Result: 在多重性感知的Two-Radius、子图计数（motif counting）以及受限链接集预测实验上，该方法均优于基线，且算术代价为O(nMd)。

Conclusion: 可寻址且基数保持的虚拟内存是一种简单有效的全局通信机制，能够在无自注意力的情况下克服虚拟节点容量瓶颈，在保持效率的同时增强MPNN的表达能力。

Abstract: Virtual nodes give message-passing neural networks a simple global communication route, but the standard node--VN--node pipeline compresses the graph into one homogeneous state and broadcasts it identically to every node. Building on the Two-Radius analysis of Mishayev et al., we ask how auxiliary virtual memory can relieve this finite-capacity bottleneck without self-attention. We identify two requirements. First, the global memory should be factorized into independently writable and readable states: this can be achieved using addressable cross-attention slots. Second, addressability alone does not preserve multiplicity, because softmax attention is invariant to uniform replication. Inserting each slot query as a private key/value anchor recovers the discarded normalization mass and yields, on bounded color domains, an injective multiset representation able to implement a 1-WL refinement. Experiments on multiplicity-aware Two-Radius, motif counting, and constrained link-set prediction support this addressable and cardinality-preserving virtual memory at (O(nMd)) arithmetic cost.

</details>


### [360] [Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs for Efficient Options Pricing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02778)
*Harris Cobb,Wenbo Hao,Yingjie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为NNLCI（局部收敛输入的神经网络）的新方法，用于提高多资产期权定价数值方法的效率。NNLCI利用神经网络对粗网格和细网格的数值解进行局部修正，仅需少量高保真训练数据，即可将细网格数值解均方根误差降低约4-12倍，适用于Black-Scholes模型下的现金或零期权（1-3维）及Heston随机波动率模型下的障碍期权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多资产期权定价在高维空间下数值方法的计算成本极高，传统方法在实时交易和风险管理中面临效率瓶颈，需要一种能够在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算需求的方案。

Method: NNLCI通过神经网络对粗网格和细网格的数值解进行局部修正，引入了最简洁的输入格式以提高便利性和效率。网络仅需极少量高保真训练数据即可训练，在测试时对粗/细网格解进行校正。

Result: 在一维至三维Black-Scholes方程下的现金或零期权以及Heston随机波动率模型下的单资产下出局障碍期权（定价PDE为二维）上进行了验证，NNLCI将细网格数值解的RMSE降低了约4-12倍，即便仅使用少量参数组合子集训练也有效。

Conclusion: NNLCI显著降低了高维期权定价问题的计算需求，具备低训练成本和强泛化能力，适用于实时期权交易和风险管理场景。

Abstract: We present a novel application of Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs (NNLCI) to improve the efficiency of existing numerical methods for pricing multi-asset options. The most concise input format for NNLCI has been introduced, offering substantial convenience and efficiency. NNLCI uses a neural network to locally correct solutions from a coarse mesh and a refined mesh (relative to the coarse one), requiring only a minimal amount of high-fidelity training data. We demonstrate this approach on cash-or-nothing options under the Black-Scholes equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, and on single-asset down-and-out barrier call options under the Heston stochastic-volatility model (whose pricing PDE is two-dimensional in the spot price $S$ and the instantaneous variance $v$). In each case, NNLCI reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the refined-mesh numerical solution by a factor of approximately 4-12 on test sets, even when the neural network is trained on only a small subset of parameter combinations. These results demonstrate that NNLCI significantly reduces computational requirements for high-dimensional problems in real-time options trading and risk management, offering low training costs and strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [361] [Evaluation Blindness: How Silent Measurement Failures Corrupt AI Systems from Training to Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02786)
*Priyanka Bajaj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"评估盲区"（evaluation blindness）概念，描述测量函数在系统实际失败时仍产生与健康状态无异读数的现象。该问题贯穿训练与部署两个生命周期阶段，通过形式化的可检测性谓词统一两者，基于四个训练期案例和50个真实生产事故的验证，发现53%的可验证公开故障是静默的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统可能静默失败，且失败会在训练循环、评估管线和生产监控栈中传播，直到下游危害显现才被察觉。现有文献将训练期与部署期的监测问题分开处理，缺乏统一的框架来理解和检测这种静默失效模式。

Method: 本文引入了评估盲区的形式化定义（测量函数M对失败类别F表现出评估盲区），并提出了一个统一训练与部署阶段的可检测性谓词。通过四个训练期案例研究（包括TRL PR #6594中的真实实现bug）和基于50个真实事故的六类分类法验证，同时提出将可接受失败率与用例风险等级关联的失败预算框架。

Result: 六类分类法经50个真实事故（来自法院文件和监管文件）验证，发现53%的可验证公开故障是静默的，其中"运营"类别在结构定义上100%静默。四个训练期案例展示了具体崩溃机制，包括损失正常下降但梯度被破坏的实际bug。

Conclusion: 测量基础设施是贯穿AI全生命周期的正确性问题，而不仅仅是评估阶段的问题。需要将评估盲区作为系统性风险来对待，并通过失败预算框架将可接受失败率与应用风险等级绑定。

Abstract: AI systems can fail silently. The failure propagates through training loops, evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring stacks until downstream harm makes it visible. This paper introduces evaluation blindness: a measurement function M exhibits evaluation blindness with respect to failure class F when it produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing, with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap.
  The problem surfaces at two lifecycle stages the literature has treated separately. At training time, reward models are gamed, importance-sampling corrections are silently miscalculated, and benchmark contamination inflates fine-tuning evaluations, all while loss curves look healthy and gradient updates proceed normally. At deployment time, monitoring fails to catch six classes of production failure, including an Operational category that is 100% silent by structural definition.
  We provide a formal detectability predicate unifying both stages. Four training-time case studies trace concrete breakdowns, including a real implementation bug in TRL PR #6594 where gradients are corrupted as loss decreases normally. A six-class taxonomy validated against 50 real-world incidents from court documents and regulatory filings finds that 53% of verifiable public failures were silent. A failure budget framework ties acceptable failure rates to use-case risk class.
  The implication is direct: measurement infrastructure is a correctness concern across the full AI lifecycle, not just at evaluation time. Data, code, and taxonomy schema are at https://github.com/priyanka25aug/llm-failure-taxonomy.

</details>


### [362] [Topological Simplification in Predictive Coding Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02816)
*Adam Shaw,Jiayu Li,Michael Sperling,Michael Kim,Alvin Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过逐层持久同调分析，定量研究了预测编码网络（PCN）中学习表征的拓扑结构变化，发现较小PCN更早发生连通分量的坍缩，且拓扑简化更晚的架构重建误差更低，PCN比匹配的MLP更晚坍缩连通分量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解预测编码网络（PCN）这种神经启发式双向架构中学习表征的拓扑结构如何随网络深度变化，以及模型容量和双向推断动力学如何影响表征的压缩与重建权衡。持久同调提供了一种无需监督标签的定量几何工具来分析分层表征。

Method: 在合成分类数据集（测试准确率≥99.9%）和MNIST（测试准确率≥95%）上训练性能良好的PCN，采用逐层持久同调分析，量化不同架构和激活函数下拓扑特征（连通分量坍缩）随层数的变化，并通过Spearman相关性、bootstrap层级比较等多种统计方法分析模型宽度、重建误差与拓扑简化深度之间的关系。

Result: （1）较小PCN跨层更早坍缩连通分量（Spearman ρ∈[0.72,0.79]），模型大小以隐层宽度之和衡量；（2）拓扑简化发生深度与重建误差呈强负相关（ρ=-0.58），即更晚简化的架构重建更好；（3）种子级bootstrap比较显示PCN始终比匹配的MLP更晚坍缩连通分量，平均相差3.6层。

Conclusion: 持久同调为PCN中的压缩-重建权衡提供了定量分析视角；模型容量和预测编码推理的循环双向动力学共同决定了跨层拓扑简化发生的时机，PCN相对于MLP的延迟拓扑坍缩可能源自其双向推断特性。

Abstract: We study the topology of learned representations in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a neuro-inspired bidirectional architecture, using a quantitative layer-wise persistent homology analysis. We train well-performing PCNs on a synthetic classification dataset ($\geq 99.9\%$ test accuracy) and on MNIST ($\geq 95\%$ test accuracy), and measure how topological features change across layers for different architectures and activation functions. We find that smaller PCNs collapse connected components across layers earlier than larger models (Spearman $\unicode{x1D70C} \in [0.72, 0.79]$ across activations), with model size measured as the sum of hidden-layer widths. We also observe a strong negative correlation ($\unicode{x1D70C} = -0.58$) between the depth at which simplification occurs and reconstruction error; i.e., architectures that simplify later reconstruct better. Finally, a seed-level bootstrap comparison across architectures and activations shows that PCNs consistently collapse connected components later than matched MLPs, with an average difference of $3.6$ layers. These results suggest that persistent homology offers a useful quantitative lens on the compression--reconstruction tradeoff in PCNs, and that both model capacity and the recurrent, bidirectional dynamics of predictive coding inference shape when this tradeoff is resolved across layers.

</details>


### [363] [Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02829)
*Ravi Satya Durga Prasad Yenugula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大模型向小模型转换的问题，以Pythia家族1.4B到410M的转换为案例，揭示了表示层强对齐而参数层弱对齐的规律，证明线性权重投影因破坏结构而功能失效，转换的价值在于初始化而非权重本身。通过匹配预算的持续预训练，解耦出最小二乘补偿（优化零样本性能）和方差保持重缩放（优化动态终点）两个独立杠杆，补偿在低预算下是令牌高效的优胜方案，但在大预算下收敛到相等，且在大规模缩放时存在过校正问题（归因于补偿求解的病态条件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型家族需要从头训练每个规模的模型，计算成本高昂。作者提出一个关键问题：能否将预训练的大模型转换为较小的兄弟模型，从而避免重复训练？理解大规模语言模型的跨规模可转换性，既有助于节省计算资源，也能深化对模型内部表示与参数结构的理解。

Method: 以Pythia家族1.4B->410M转换为研究对象：（i）用岭回归（R^2=0.84）刻画表示层对齐，对比参数层对齐；（ii）分析稠密权重投影为何功能失效——证明不是装配伪影，而是基混合破坏了旋转位置编码、逐头注意力、GELU和层归一化结构；（iii）通过洗牌对照验证最优线性算子后的残差在统计上与噪声无异；（iv）在匹配预算的持续预训练中，解耦出最小二乘补偿（用于零样本性能）和方差保持重缩放（用于动态终点）两个独立杠杆，并进行多规模（宽度缩减、深度缩减、6.9B->1.4B）实验验证。

Result: 表示层强对齐（R^2=0.84）而参数层弱对齐；权重投影是结构破坏性的而非装配伪影；线性投影后残差与噪声无异。补偿在30M令牌下击败最强子克隆变体（宽度缩减对84.0±1.8 vs 89.7±3.7，深度缩减对109.3 vs 117.9，均为3/3种子），但33倍预算后收敛到持平（40.0 vs 40.0）。转移初始化始终优于从头训练，低预算下最多节省18倍令牌，差距随收敛和规模增大而缩小。在6.9B->1.4B（约5倍供体规模）时双杠杆叠加过校正，追溯到宽尺度下补偿求解的病态条件。

Conclusion: 大模型转小模型的转换价值在于初始化而非权重本身。最小二乘补偿是低成本、令牌高效的短期优化手段，而非普适方案；在更大的规模下需要维度感知的正则化来解决病态条件问题。该工作为跨规模模型转换提供了系统性的经验边界和可行的改进方向。

Abstract: Model families train every size from scratch. Can a pretrained large model be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end-to-end: (i) representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly; (ii) dense weight projection is functionally destructive -- provably not an assembly artifact -- because basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure; (iii) after the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls; (iv) conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers -- least-squares compensation (function: best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics: best endpoints). Compensation is a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one: at 30M tokens it beats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8 vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens; at a 33x larger budget the two converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer initialization always beats -- by up to 18x at low budget, the margin narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We further map the method's boundary: at ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, which we trace to ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as the fix. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.

</details>


### [364] [NOMADD: Numerical Optimization of Models Adapting to Data Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02845)
*Swapn Shah,Keith Burghardt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种后处理的、模型无关的概念漂移缓解方法。该方法将基础模型在每个标记训练周期上单独拟合，度量其参数相对于锚模型的变化，通过低秩分解压缩这些变化，并用阻尼正则化预测外推每个潜在因子。在18个数据集的Drift-Resilient TabPFN基准上，该方法对每种基础模型族均实现性能提升，仅需数秒训练即可达到与SOTA相当的性能，而SOTA方法需1,300 GPU小时预训练且推理慢数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格模型在特征分布变化（数据漂移）或特征与目标关系变化（概念漂移）时性能会退化。现有降漂移工具通常针对神经网络架构定制，且需要在训练过程中适应。实际场景中，标签数据可能不可及时获得，重新训练模型也可能不切实际，因此需要一种快速、后处理、可泛化到多种模型的方法来减轻概念漂移。

Method: 算法在各自标记训练周期上分别拟合基础模型，测量其参数相对锚模型（在所有周期上池化得到）的演化；用低秩分解压缩参数变化；采用阻尼、正则化的预测模型将每个潜在因子外推至未来；最后将外推结果应用于最终预测。

Result: 在Drift-Resilient TabPFN基准（18个数据集，按该基准自身协议和指标评估）上，该外推方法对所有应用的基础模型族均带来了改进，性能与Drift-Resilient TabPFN相当，但训练仅需数秒；相比之下，Drift-Resilient TabPFN需在约1,300 GPU小时内在数百万合成数据集上预训练，且推理速度慢多个数量级。

Conclusion: 提出了一种实用、高效且模型无关的概念漂移后处理缓解工具，在多个模型族上表现出竞争力，并探讨了将该工具扩展到其他模态的前景与挑战。

Abstract: Tabular model performance degrades when feature distributions change over time or the relationship between features and outcome variables change over time, known as data drift and concept drift, respectively. These issues are challenging to mitigate in real time because labeled data may not be immediately available, or re-training a model could be impractical. While tools exist to reduce drift, they are typically bespoke to neural network architectures and adapt how models are trained. In this paper, we offer an alternative post-hoc method to reduce concept drift, which is applicable to a variety of models, from trees to neural networks to tabular foundation models. This new tool is especially useful when constraints, such as high model accuracy, bounded inference time, or model size requires users to choose between different models for their specific use-cases. Our algorithm fits the base model separately on each labeled training period, measures how its parameters evolve against a single anchor model pooled over all of those periods, compresses those changes with a low-rank factorization, and extrapolates each latent factor forward with a damped, regularized forecast. On the 18-dataset Drift-Resilient TabPFN benchmark, evaluated under that benchmark's own protocol and metric, the extrapolation improves every base family it is applied to, and achieves performance competitive with the state-of-the-art Drift-Resilient TabPFN with seconds of training. In contrast, Drift-Resilient TabPFN requires pre-training on millions of synthetic datasets over approximately 1,300 GPU-hours, and is orders of magnitude slower in inference (depending on the model). In the discussion, we explore the promise and challenges of extending this tool to other modalities.

</details>


### [365] [Adaptive Sampling for Automated Post-Disaster Rapid Damage Assessment via Level-Set Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02868)
*Boyang Xu,Mostafa Reisi Gahrooei,Mohammad Ilbeigi,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种结合成本感知贝叶斯优化与水平集估计的框架，用于引导无人机等自主数据采集器持续向最具信息量的区域移动，实现动态、低成本且准确的灾后建筑损毁评估，并在合成数据与R2D仿真数据上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统灾后损毁评估依赖静态且劳动密集型的数据采集策略，成本高昂且难以适应灾后动态变化的环境，亟需一种快速、可靠且经济高效的自动化损伤评估方法以支持应急响应。

Method: 提出一种成本感知的贝叶斯优化框架，结合水平集估计（level-set estimation），持续引导自主数据采集器（如无人机）前往信息量最高的区域；通过动态更新不同地理区域的损伤估计，在最小化运行成本的同时系统性地降低预测不确定性。

Result: 在受控合成玩具研究中，该方法能高效追踪损伤边界、恢复底层损伤地图并快速降低预测不确定性；在高保真度的R2D仿真灾后数据上，算法提供了准确及时的损伤估计，支持信息充分且快速的应急响应。

Conclusion: 所提出的成本感知贝叶斯优化与水平集估计相结合的方法，能够在降低采集成本的同时提供准确及时的灾后损毁评估，为灾害应急响应提供有效支撑。
